responsibility: Implements loop array prefetching on GIMPLE. For each loop it gathers memory references, analyzes temporal and spatial reuse plus dependence distance, estimates profitable prefetch distance and unroll factors using target cache/prefetch parameters and loop-size heuristics, selects a bounded set of prefetch candidates, optionally unrolls the loop to satisfy prefetch cadence constraints, and emits __builtin_prefetch operations and related non-temporal store markings.
